title: Field Shuffle (REDCap External Module)
description: Field Shuffle is a REDCap External Module for randomizing the display order of fields on REDCap survey pages, data entry forms, and native multi-page surveys. It stores the realized order in a designated text field, replays valid stored orders, and supports independent fields, fixed-order blocks, fixed page structures, one-unit-per-page randomization, internal subgroup shuffling, and page-header overrides.
